extDescription.message: Yengeza i-physics ezintweni ze-HTML kuthebhu yamanje ukuze uzijabulise.

physicsOnStatus.message: I-physics ivuliwe. Cindezela u-Escape noma okuthi "Buyisela ikhasi" ukuze uyivale.

physicsOnNote.message: Ukunyakazisa iwindi lesiphequluli sakho kuvula i-physics. Cindezela okuthi "Buyisela ikhasi" noma u-Esc ukuze uyivale.

gravityHint.message: Ku-0 ikhasi lihlala liyitafula eliyisicaba. Kwenyuse ukuze izingcezu ziwe.

airDragHint.message: Ukuthi izingcezu eziphonswe zehlisa ijubane ngokushesha kangakanani.

bounceHint.message: Ukuthi izingcezu zigxuma kangakanani uma zishayisana noma zishaya imiphetho yewindi.

frictionHint.message: Ukuthi izingcezu 'zibambeka' kangakanani uma zishelela zidlulana.

dragStrengthHint.message: Ukuthi ucezu lulandela isikhombi sakho eduze kangakanani.

shakeDistanceHint.message: Ukuthi iwindi kufanele lihambe ibanga elingakanani ngaphambi kokushintsha indlela ukuze kubalwe njengokunyakazisa okukodwa.

shakeSpeedHint.message: Ukuthi iwindi kufanele lihambe ngokushesha kangakanani ukuze ukunyakazisa kubalwe, ukuze ukuhamba kancane kungakuqalisi.

shakesNeededHint.message: Ukuthi kudingeka ukunyakazisa okungaki ukuze kuqale.

timeToShakeHint.message: Ukuthi ukunyakazisa okungu-$count$ kufanele kwenzeke ngokushesha kangakanani ukuze kuqale i-physics.

hideRestoreButtonHint.message: Ifihla inkinobho ethi "Buyisela ikhasi" evela ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesokudla uma i-physics ivuliwe.

tipStart.message: Bamba iwindi ngebha yesihloko bese ulinyakazisa, NOMA uchofoze isithonjana sesandiso.

tipRestore.message: Cindezela u-Esc, uchofoze inkinobho ethi Buyisela ikhasi, NOMA uchofoze isithonjana sesandiso ukuze ubuyisele ikhasi.

resetFailed.message: Ayikwazanga ukusetha kabusha amasethingi. Zama futhi.
